items.title: Serre vanishing on affines (retained with the author's slogan block): for a quasi-coherent module F on a scheme X and any affine open U, the cohomology H^p(U, F) vanishes for all p > 0.
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The proof instantiates the Cohomology chapter's Cech-vanishing basis criterion inside the span: choose as basis the affine opens and as designated coverings the standard affine coverings; condition (1) (vanishing of Cech groups on basis elements for chosen coverings) is supplied by this chapter's own standard-covering triviality lemma (card L16367); condition (2) (cofinality of standard coverings) is the schemes-lemma-standard-open; the intersection stability of standard opens inside an affine is verified in the text, closing the third condition.
